newsitem.title: FINLAND: EFORE SAYS TO SELL LAMBDA PRODUCTS.
newsitem.headline: EFORE SAYS TO SELL LAMBDA PRODUCTS.

text.p: Finnish electronics components maker Efore Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had agreed to represent Coutant Lambda in Finland, Russia and the Baltic countries.
"Lambda is currently the biggest power supply manufacturer in the world," Efore said, adding it would start selling Lambda products in May.
Coutant Lambda is the global parent of Nemic-Lambda, a listed Japanese company, Efore chairman Hannes Fabritius said by telephone.
Efore said the contract meant it would have a wider product range and Lambda would gain a new, efficient sales channel.
"In addition to the present custom-designed power supplies and rectifier systems, Efore is now able to offer its customers standard power supplies," it said.
